description: Conservative offline analysis of an unknown private binary stream. It infers only repeated self-consistent length-prefix framing, then clusters, aligns, and proposes field candidates without truth labels.
limitations: Only repeated length-prefixed hypotheses that cover the complete input are accepted automatically.
Message clusters are statistical groups, not confirmed protocol message types.
Field candidates and length relations are hypotheses; encrypted, compressed, delimited, or fixed-length formats can correctly remain unframed.
